name: side lying scissors
description: Lying on your side, you open and close the legs like scissors. Good for the outer hips and the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
